updates.title: OQTF: procedural deadlines restructured in June 2026
updates.text: General, assignation and rétention procedures must now be separated carefully.
updates.before: Older summaries often reduced OQTF deadlines to a simple 48h/15d/30d table tied mainly to the type of OQTF.
updates.now: Current CESEDA uses a general one-month track and accelerated assignation/rétention tracks, with special 5/7-day exceptions in R921-2-1.
updates.impact: Do not infer a filing deadline from voluntary-departure wording alone. Read notification, procedural status and voies et délais de recours.
updates.who: Anyone receiving or contesting OQTF, especially after assignation à résidence or rétention.

updates.title: PFU 2026: social prélèvements change the headline total
updates.text: For many ordinary capital incomes, the current headline PFU is 31.4% in 2026.
updates.before: The widely remembered total was 30%: 12.8% IR + 17.2% social prélèvements.
updates.now: For relevant ordinary revenus de capitaux mobiliers in 2026, impots.gouv.fr indicates 12.8% IR + 18.6% social prélèvements = 31.4%, with exceptions for certain products and possible barème option.
updates.impact: Do not reuse a 2025 flat-tax calculator mechanically for 2026 distributions.
updates.who: Physical-person shareholders receiving relevant dividends or other capital income.

updates.title: TVA: BOFiP republishes 2026 franchise thresholds
updates.text: For ordinary services, BOFiP confirms 37,500 € and the 41,250 € current-year majoré threshold.
updates.before: 2025 reform debates created uncertainty over a proposed single lower threshold.
updates.now: The 01.07.2026 BOFiP states ordinary services threshold 37,500 € and current-year majoré threshold 41,250 €; exceeding the latter ends franchise from the date of exceedance.
updates.impact: Invoice logic may have to change immediately at the exceedance date, not next January.
updates.who: Businesses using franchise en base TVA, subject to category-specific exceptions.

updates.title: SCI and location meublée: commercial nature remains a tax trigger
updates.text: Systematic furnished rental by an SCI requires IS analysis, subject to a limited administrative tolerance.
updates.before: Owners often treated all rental income as civil simply because the asset was real estate.
updates.now: Official tax guidance treats location meublée as commercial for SCI tax purposes and describes a limited tolerance when commercial receipts stay within 10% of total receipts.
updates.impact: Model IR/IS before launching furnished rental and do not treat the tolerance as a universal safe harbor.

updates.title: Entrepreneur/profession libérale: L421-6 transition logic applies from 2026
updates.text: A person moving from another residence basis to a first pluriannual entrepreneur route passes through a temporary one-year card when conditions are met.
updates.before: Earlier L421-6 did not contain the same 2026 transitional wording for first pluriannual issue from another motif.
updates.now: Current L421-6 provides the one-year temporary entrepreneur/profession libérale card before the first pluriannual card in the specified situation, if conditions are met.
updates.impact: Do not describe the post-student or other status change as an automatic immediate four-year card.
updates.who: Foreign nationals changing from another titre to entrepreneur/profession libérale.

updates.title: Naturalisation: 2026 civics requirements require current verification
updates.text: Naturalisation preparation must use current language/civics requirements and current official materials.
updates.before: Older preparation content can refer to previous integration/civics framework.
updates.now: LexiFrance marks the naturalisation lesson as date-sensitive and points users to current official rules rather than treating historical requirements as permanent.
updates.impact: Check the official rule in force at the filing date and avoid relying on old checklists.
updates.who: Applicants preparing naturalisation or long-term residence transitions.
